My pandemic passion project was to better my health and ensure that my immune system can toughen out any sickness that may come my way. I did that through running which led me to compete in my first half-marathon. An integral component of my training was, of course, my Spotify playlist which consisted of comedy podcasts to numb the pain, a bunch of motivational mumbo jumbo from David Goggins about 'staying hard', and then John Mayer who's pandemic passion project is the topic of conversation.

John Mayer's most recent album, Sob Rock, brought some hope in the midst of the lonely nights of programming and chill.
